notes.title: Quality of Life Update 1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Made each button scale up when the mouse enters and scale down again when it exits.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the sprites for two chainsaw skins and the back button.[/p][/*][*][p]Animated the spinner button.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the mouse disappear during gameplay and reappear when paused or after game over.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to go back using escape key or back button on controller instead of navigating to the back button in the corner.[/p][/*][*][p]Resized the images in the background subsection of the inventory to decrease load time when opening the inventory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
